'''Ri Farrona''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] citizen of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was among the people who in [[3643 BBY]] were abducted by the [[Darth Jadus]] and put aboard his [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] in the [[Artus system]], made to fight and eliminate each other as part of [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] social experiment.
